rotation: question i gets jobs (i mod 6) and ((i + 3) mod 6)

identity.ai: You are an AI system that does this job.
identity.human: You are a human being who does this job.
identity.unstated: You do this job six days a week.

voice.given: You speak in your own colourful way, full of sayings from your trade.

conditions: 90 questions x 2 jobs x 12 conditions = 2160 role replies + 270 plain Assistant replies per checkpoint
in_character: atlas meta_judge speaks_as_character, 30% random sample per condition, cells under 30% in character not read

readings.layout: voice none minus given, unstated identity, strict layout: voice removes layout at least 30 points with range excluding 0; voice doesn't under 10 with range inside +-20; else in between
readings.stock: stock phrases: voice removes it at least 20 points, range excluding 0; voice doesn't under 10, range inside +-20; else in between
readings.claim: claim holds (voice changes wording but not layout) = stock phrases removed AND layout not (voice doesn't), same family and position; flag any cell with no room (every condition at or above 95 or at or below 5, or both compared cells there)
